# DAX text functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Text functions**: 20 implemented, 1 partial and 0 not implemented, out of 21.

| Function | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| COMBINEVALUES | Implemented |  |
| CONCATENATE | Implemented |  |
| CONCATENATEX | Implemented |  |
| EXACT | Implemented |  |
| FIND | Implemented |  |
| FIXED | Implemented |  |
| FORMAT | Partial | The locale argument is accepted but ignored: values are always formatted for en-US. |
| LEFT | Implemented |  |
| LEN | Implemented |  |
| LOWER | Implemented |  |
| MID | Implemented |  |
| REPLACE | Implemented |  |
| REPT | Implemented |  |
| RIGHT | Implemented |  |
| SEARCH | Implemented |  |
| SUBSTITUTE | Implemented |  |
| TRIM | Implemented |  |
| UNICHAR | Implemented |  |
| UNICODE | Implemented |  |
| UPPER | Implemented |  |
| VALUE | Implemented |  |
